meta.purpose: Choose the billing structure. Each model changes client behavior, cash flow, and scalability.
meta.source: Service Pricing Cost Calculation (4 pricing models) + compass_artifact (retainer emphasis).

hourly_time_and_materials.definition: Client billed linearly for exact time spent.

project_fixed_fee.definition: Flat predefined fee for delineated deliverables, regardless of hours.
project_fixed_fee.use_for: Defined-scope builds (apps, sites, 3D videos). Pair with change-order process.

retainer.definition: Recurring monthly/quarterly fee for ongoing access or baseline deliverables.
cons: Requires constant value demonstration to prevent churn
Scope can creep beyond negotiated baseline
retainer.use_for: Maintenance, social management, ads, ongoing video. TARGET 70-80% of revenue recurring.

value_based.definition: Fee anchored to quantifiable client business impact, not labor cost. Most sophisticated/lucrative.
cons: Needs executive access + proven ROI history
Fails if impact can't be isolated/measured
value_based.calibration: Typically 10-20% of created value. e.g. $5,000 fee for a system that saves the client $50,000/yr.

tactical_rules.no_line_item_pricing: Don't itemize every task (invites a-la-carte negotiation). Bundle into outcome-oriented tiers ('Full Transformation Sprint: $X').
tactical_rules.options_not_discounts: Offer 3 tiers (Basic/Standard/Premium) to anchor. If client pushes on price, REDUCE SCOPE to match budget — never discount the fee (it permanently resets perceived value).
tactical_rules.phased_rollout: Never change pricing across the whole base at once. Segment cohorts, A/B test on new clients, measure conversion + churn.
tactical_rules.separate_ad_spend: Quote ads management SEPARATELY from the ad budget in every social proposal.
